name: Serve
opening: You always let me serve first.
closing:
You sent it back
where I could reach.

name: Between
closing:
Straight back.
Neither of us was keeping score.

name: Hold
closing:
Your bus went.
You sent it back.

name: Serve
opening:
For a moment,
there was your wrist.
closing:
I moved closer
to hear the little knock.

name: Angle
opening:
Look.
I'm putting it somewhere else.
closing:
Your wrist went to the old corner.
You would have followed me.

name: Between
closing:
Once, you missed
because you were watching my hand.

name: Hold
closing:
It came on time.
It would have come without me.

name: Again?
opening: I could stay here all night.
closing:
It remembered how you moved.
It couldn't notice I was here.

name: Serve
closing: I waited for the little knock.

name: Angle
opening: You used to lean in for this one.
closing:
I wanted to show you
something you hadn't seen.

name: Between
closing:
I set out one cup.
Then reached for yours.

name: Hold
closing:
I was ready for you.
I still was.

name: Again?
opening:
I could miss you
away from this machine.
